events.description: Application (24A407) for a stay, submitted to The Chief Justice.
Response to application (24A407) requested by The Chief Justice, due by 3 p.m. (EDT) on October 29, 2024.
Brief amicus curiae of Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections, Inc. filed.
Brief amicus curiae of National Election Integrity Association filed.
Brief amicus curiae of Kansas, et al. filed.
Response to application from respondent Virginia Coalition for Immigrant Rights, et al. filed.
Response to application from respondent United States filed.
Brief amicus curiae of American Center for Law and Justice filed.
Brief amicus curiae of Republican National Committee and Republican Party of Virginia filed.
Brief amicus curiae of Honest Elections Project filed.
Brief amicus curiae of Former Members of Congress filed.
Amicus brief of FormerFedsGroup Freedom Foundation, et. al. not accepted for filing. (Printed copies not received by Clerk. See Rule 37.4.)

Application (24A407) for stay presented to The Chief Justice and by him referred to the Court is granted. The October 25, 2024 order of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia, case Nos. 1:24-cv-1778 and 1:24-cv-1807, is stayed pending the disposition of the appeal in the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit and disposition of a petition for a writ of certiorari, if such a writ is timely sought. Should certiorari be denied, this stay shall terminate automatically. In the event certiorari is granted, the stay shall terminate upon the sending down of the judgment of this Court. Justice Sotomayor, Justice Kagan, and Justice Jackson, would deny the application.
